subject.title: fix: support baseURL alias in memory embedding provider config resolution

question: Should OpenClaw accept `models.providers.*.baseURL` as a core input-only compatibility alias for canonical `baseUrl`?
rationale: Provider endpoint config is compatibility and security-boundary sensitive, and automation cannot decide whether this OpenAI-SDK-style spelling should become a supported core contract.

options.title: Accept input-only alias
options.body: Accept the alias at schema parse time, keep runtime output canonical, and land with the supplied endpoint proof plus maintainer review.

options.title: Keep core canonical-only
options.body: Decline or pause this PR and require users to use `baseUrl` in core provider config while preserving plugin-owned compatibility where already documented.

options.title: Defer to routing cluster
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose one coordinated landing path among the overlapping memory endpoint-routing PRs.

recommendation.title: Accept input-only alias
recommendation.body: Accept the alias at schema parse time, keep runtime output canonical, and land with the supplied endpoint proof plus maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across memory-host embedding resolution, Ollama provider alias handling, and related documentation.
